note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (caretaker SPÖ-ÖVP government after the October 1999 election), not measured data. Influence reflects Austria's social partnership, in which the chambers (labour, economic and agricultural) and the trade union federation are institutionally embedded, a strong farming lobby, a significant Catholic Church, and a conscript army under civilian control.
